preview.modelExplainer: Our model weights SG Total highest at 9%, followed by SG ATG 1%) and SG APP 5%), making ball-striking and short-game recovery the primary drivers. SG OTT 8%) and SG PUTT 8%), bogey avoidance 0%), and birdie/bogey ratio 0%) are minor factors.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by combining tournament rank and power rank, prioritizing those with strong SG APP and SG ATG numbers. Lower-tier exposure is limited to players with outlier SG PUTT or SG ATG upside that the model may undervalue.

article.title: Presidents Cup 2026: Model Ranks Scheffler, Lee, Morikawa as Top Targets at Medinah
article.dek: Strokes-gained model places Scheffler #1, Lee #2, and Morikawa #3 for the 24-player field at Medinah CC (No. 3).
article.introduction: The tournament model ranks Scottie Scheffler first with 868 SG Total, Min Woo Lee second at 693, and Collin Morikawa third at 53. Course weights emphasize SG Total 9%), SG Around-the-Green 1%), and SG Approach 5%). All three players share the same post-Open research profile: DID_NOT_PLAY finish, skipped Scottish Open, and zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload window.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The Presidents Cup at Medinah CC (No. 3) features a 24-player field. The model weights SG Total at 9%, SG Around-the-Green at 1%, and SG Approach at 5%.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Scheffler's 868 SG Total leads the field; Lee's 693 SG Total and Morikawa's 53 SG Total place second and third. SG Around-the-Green and SG Approach carry the next-highest course weights.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Scheffler posts the top SG Total 868) and power rank (1). Lee ranks second in SG Total 693) and eighth in power rank. Morikawa ranks third in SG Total 53) and ninth in power rank.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three players show NO_TRACKED_ROUNDS in the major-swing workload window. Each player is classified DID_NOT_PLAY at the Open and skipped the Scottish Open.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Scheffler holds FedExCup rank #1 and is SAFE_TOP_50. Lee sits at FedExCup rank #21 and is SAFE_TOP_50. Morikawa is FedExCup rank #7 and is SAFE_TOP_50.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each player combines a top-10 model rank with the skipped-Scottish-Open flag. Scheffler, Lee, and Morikawa all carry this crossover classification.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Model rank #1 Scottie Scheffler and model rank #2 Min Woo Lee are the outright targets. Both players post SG Total marks above 6 and power ranks inside the top 10.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Scheffler (model rank 1), Lee (model rank 2), and Morikawa (model rank 3) form the top-10 card. Their SG Total values are 868, 693, and 53 respectively.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players—Scheffler, Lee, and Morikawa—are the top-20 targets. All three hold model ranks inside the top three and power ranks inside the top 10.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are not available in this pipeline; the article does not make weather- or tee-time-specific claims.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Scottie Scheffler outright, top-5, top-10, top-20. Tier 2 (model-supported): Min Woo Lee outright, top-5, top-10, top-20. Tier 3 (model-supported): Collin Morikawa top-10, top-20.

article.conclusion: Tier 1: Scottie Scheffler across all cards. Tier 2: Min Woo Lee across all cards. Tier 3: Collin Morikawa top-10 and top-20 only.
